title: packages: 30 of 39 published packages declare no sideEffects, so consumers cannot tree-shake them; declare per package now, make registration explicit later so the 1,380-line array gate can go
body:
Filing gate ③: a maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, 2026-10-24, verbatim: 「同意：建议新建：与合并无关、独立成卡的产品/契约项（可现在建）」, approving the review's list of independent product / contract cards. Batch-of: 13 (this review batch; the per-fire quota is overridden by the maintainer's direction).

## 维护者速读

39 个发布包里 **30 个没有 `sideEffects` 字段**（false 5、true 2、数组 2）。字段缺失在 webpack / Rollup / Vite 消费者那里等于「每个模块都可能有副作用」，整个包不能摇树——这正是 `check-side-effects-array.mjs` 自己文件头量过的代价（app-shell 漏写时 console 首屏多出约 3.3 MB gzip）。而那个 1,380 行的门禁只校验两个包的数组。短期逐包声明；长期把「导入即注册」改成显式 `register*()`，每个包都能写 `false`，门禁随之删除。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384; manifest census)

- `sideEffects` present in 9 of 39 published manifests: `false` in core, i18n, react-runtime, sdui-parser, types; `true` in components, fields; arrays in app-shell (18 entries) and layout. Absent in the other 30: auth, cli, collaboration, create-plugin, data-objectstack, mobile, permissions, providers, react, runner, every `plugin-*` except none, console.
- `scripts/check-side-effects-array.mjs` (1,380 lines) validates exactly the two array packages; its header records the measured cost of an omitted field on app-shell.
- The plugin packages register on import (`ComponentRegistry.register(…)` at module top level; `apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts` imports five of them for the side effect), so for them an honest value today is an array or `true`; pure libraries (react, providers, permissions, mobile, auth, collaboration, data-objectstack) can say `false` after a read of each entry.
- Business reason: every external host that bundles `@object-ui/*` pays for code it never calls; the console's own first-load budget (objectui#13447, objectstack-ai/objectui#11798) is the in-house symptom of the same mechanism.
- Dedup (`sideEffects`): 12 hits, 2 open — objectui#13410 (app-shell pulling the chatbot root; the consumer-side symptom) and a Dependabot bump; closed: objectstack-ai/objectui#11963, objectstack-ai/objectui#12362 (registration observability). No card asks for the field on the 30 packages.

## Task

- [ ] Per package: `false` for the pure libraries, an array (the existing gate in `--list` mode helps derive it) or `true` for packages that register on import. `sideEffects` is one of the eight contract fields, so each change carries a changeset.
- [ ] Longer term (decision in its own card when ready): explicit registration (`register*()` exports, no import-time mutation) so every package can declare `false` and `check-side-effects-array.mjs` is deleted.
- [ ] 未实测: consumer bundle delta — measure with `check-eager-closure-budget` on `apps/console` before and after.

Who acts: objectui `domain:ui` seat, one PR for the declarations. Effort M (30 manifests, each read). Risk: a wrong `false` drops a live registration (the objectui#6535 failure class) — run the gate per package before landing.

Filed by the read-only whole-repo review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` on 2026-10-24, written through the maintainer's own account token (the session holds no fleet-bot credential). Evidence files: that session's scratchpad (`objectui-review-report.md`, `findings-*.md`). ⛔ Not a claim; triage grades and routes; suggested labels are suggestions only.
